H1.pregunta: Why do I keep waking up in front of the Mouth?
H1.respuesta: The Chamber of the Absent holds the last fifteen minutes using the instant of the collapse; it has run on its own since they left.

H2.respuesta: Every use of a Gate drifts its two clocks apart; past the Limit it collapses, and the network spreads the collapse to all of them.

H3.respuesta: They died fleeing through the very Gates that condemned them; the evacuation sped up the cascade.

H4.respuesta: The Council hid the danger; the researcher and the skeptic worked in secret.

H5.respuesta: At the Slow Place, hidden behind the lens of the Knot: what you see in the sky is displaced.

H6.respuesta: By replacing the engine of the machine at the Scar with the Counterweight, its clock synchronized, during the pulse.

H7.pregunta: How and when do I get home?
H7.respuesta: The mouths have different clocks: you must leave by the one that arrives before the Institute's great test.
